lines.text: A muddy @dog_rex bounds through the park and leaps into @maya_front's arms, knocking her hat off.
Wide, then a whip pan to the catch.

new_beats.text: The best hellos are a little muddy.

writes.note: I added one short VO line over the shot and kept your words as they were.
